retired.Magical Resistance Rating Cap: #702 (2026-09-04): retired, not re-recorded. The name left the rankable set because it was an alias VARIANT all along — gear-planner spells the same set bonus Magical Sheltering Cap, and the only carrier of this spelling was the hand-curated augment_sets.json seed (the entry's own claim that gear-planner's Adherent of the Mists tiers carry it was wrong: raw/gearplanner_sets.json has no such spelling). It now resolves through affix_aliases.json; the canonical contains no detector head-word, so it needs no ruling of its own.

_meta.note: #211 detector rulings. Each entry settles a flagged candidate as `atomic` — a real distinct stat, not an umbrella — with the rendered-tooltip reading (or the standing wiki-evidence ruling) that proves it. The disposition vocabulary is CLOSED at ['atomic']: a name a mechanism models (an expansion family in src/spell_focus.py/_UNIVERSAL, src/umbrella.py, a split module, or a cross-add source) must NOT carry an entry — its registration resolves it, and the detector rejects a stale entry. An unadjudicated candidate FAILS THE BUILD. See docs/wiki-evidence/umbrella-adjudication-sweep.md.

Blighted Lore.evidence: Blighted Lore: a Combined Spell Lore. Spell_Lore section 'Combined Spell Lore' — "Certain, rare enchantments provide bonus Spell Critical chance to multiple elements" — lists it against a FIXED element set: Acid + Negative + Poison + Evil (Specifically Evil, not other alignments or Light). It is its own enchantment over its own elements, not an umbrella over the ten-name 'Types of spell lore' roster, and no wiki statement ties a universal lore name to a combined-lore name. Flagged only because #366 made 'Lore' a family head-word; the pre-existing deliberate exclusion in src/cross_add.py is unchanged. Expanding it on the resemblance would be inference, which the data gate forbids.
